register_expr_namespace: register a custom namespace on Polars Expr to add methods like next, previous, nearest for power-of-n calculations
register_dataframe_namespace: register a custom namespace on Polars DataFrame to add methods like splitting by column name or value prefixes
register_lazyframe_namespace: register a custom namespace on Polars LazyFrame to add methods like splitting by column dtypes or upcasting integer types
register_series_namespace: register a custom namespace on Polars Series to add methods like square and cube for mathematical operations
create_namespace_decorator: create a namespace decorator factory that registers custom accessor classes on Polars DataFrame, Expr, LazyFrame, or Series
